agent_notes: SCANNER BUG: batch_scan.py:147 computes lowercase_in_target by searching the LOWERCASED token against the LOWERCASED target, so the flag is True for every member and carries no information. Every member here instead carries lowercase_in_target_verified and lowercase_in_corpus_verified, measured case-sensitively against the target and against notes/spell_pass_batch/corpus_all.txt.

Lowercase gate applied corpus-wide, not just in-target. Three otherwise-correct readings were downgraded to no_rule because the wrong-form occurs lowercase as a legitimate English word: Lucrative (-> Vukradin; 'This is lucrative.'), Grant (-> Treant; 'I'm going to grant myself bardic inspiration'), Vantage (-> advantage; 'From this vantage point').

One documented exception to that gate: 'Ferry Fire' has 2 lowercase corpus occurrences, but both are the same mis-transcription by the same player, so an IGNORECASE row fixes them rather than corrupting them.

Out of scope for this pass but worth the GM knowing: sibling reads 'Find Soma the bear' where the target reads 'Find some of the bear'. A lowercase wrong-form of a PC name can never surface as a capitalised-unknown candidate, so this class of error is invisible to the current pipeline.
'Myra' (in 'Myra… Pass… so she turns to the bard', sibling: 'Lyra casts') is not in the known set, has no glossary row, and yet was never emitted as a candidate. Possible gap in find_unknowns.
